sourceScope: Only the three admitted owned source files changed. No registry, feature map, generated file, external spec, or other source file was edited.

changes: Added canonical DelegationArtifactManifestEntry schema/type and inventory entry.
The DTO uses reports-relative lexical paths, the five specified media types, bytes 0..2 MiB, digestSchema, and the existing canonical observationRefSchema.
Added optional ModelRouteDelegationReceiptV1.resultRefs (maximum eight) and DELEGATION_RESULT_REFUSED. Optionality preserves the legacy synthetic receipt constructor.
All new producer receipts include resultRefs: [].
Research captures only normalized output text events and retains at most 2 MiB measured as UTF-8 bytes; overflow clears the captured chunks and refuses the result.

Completed research requires non-whitespace output, writes exactly reports/delegation-result.md under the retained export, checks the export/reports directory and symlink boundary, creates the file exclusively with O_NOFOLLOW, rereads persisted bytes, and derives the manifest byte count/digest from those bytes.
Missing, empty, overlimit, or unsafe/unpersistable output returns DELEGATION_RESULT_REFUSED with no refs. Ordinary implementation remains Luna/max/Fast with no research ref.
Existing route-skill ATs retain their exact nine case IDs. AT-self-improvement-56 selects those nine plus its four planned result cases.

The positive AT-56 case independently reads the retained file through the fake executor's captured workspace and checks fixed path containment, regular-file status, media type, byte count, returned digest, and digest against the fixed synthetic output emitted by the fake.

Missing, empty, and overlimit cases assert completed valid route plus refusal/no ref/no file. The symlink case uses a disposable outside-export directory and sentinel, asserts unchanged sentinel/no extra file, then cleans the fixture.
CheckView evidence is compact and includes canonical result refs/readback booleans, not output text or raw OS errors, to fit the existing 2,000-character contract.
